text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон is Miho Dormitory's
beloved dorm
leader—a hot-blooded
runner with a passion for
one-on-one
challenges.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To her, races aren't just about running,
they're
about the fiery competition with
fearsome rivals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's excited to see what challenges
await her in
the upcoming Twinkle
Series. Now, it's time to
charge into
battle with her!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
